title: STAC: Scales and Tasks for Art and Creativity Assessment
description: Curated, open archive of scales and tasks for research on creativity, aesthetics and the arts, plus individual-differences measures commonly used alongside them. Each release contains all instrument files (unchanged author versions), README and machine-readable stac.yml metadata. Please cite the original source of each instrument version.

creators.name: Silvia, Paul J.
creators.affiliation: University of North Carolina at Greensboro

notes: Access conditions are set per instrument (see stac.yml access.tier). Default: free for academic and non-commercial use.
